title.en: When Anger Puffs Up Like a Balloon

ko.title: 빨개진 얼굴
ko.body: 다람쥐 토토는 쌓아 둔 도토리 탑이 와르르 무너지자 얼굴이 빨개졌어요. 가슴속에서 무언가 풍선처럼 부풀어 올랐지요.

en.title: A Red, Red Face
en.body: Toto's tower of acorns came tumbling down, and his face turned bright red. Something puffed up inside his chest, like a balloon.

ko.title: 부푸는 화 풍선
ko.body: 화가 나면 마음속 빨간 풍선이 점점 커졌어요. 풍선이 너무 커지면 토토는 발을 쿵쿵 굴렀지요.

en.title: The Anger Balloon Grows
en.body: When Toto got angry, a red balloon swelled bigger and bigger inside him. When it grew too big, he stomped his feet.
en.line: The balloon just kept puffing up and up.

ko.title: 엄마가 알려 준 비밀
ko.body: 엄마 다람쥐가 다가와 조용히 말했어요. 화가 날 땐 풍선의 바람을 천천히 빼면 된다고요.

en.title: Mom's Little Secret
en.body: Mom squirrel came close and spoke softly. When you're angry, she said, you can let the air out of the balloon slowly.

ko.title: 깊은 숨 한 번
ko.body: 토토는 코로 들이쉬고 입으로 후우 내쉬었어요. 한 번, 두 번, 세 번 숨을 쉬자 풍선이 조금 작아졌지요.

en.title: One Deep Breath
en.body: Toto breathed in through his nose and out through his mouth. One, two, three breaths, and the balloon grew a little smaller.

ko.title: 하나, 둘, 셋
ko.body: 엄마는 마음속으로 숫자를 세어 보자고 했어요. 하나, 둘, 셋을 세는 동안 화가 천천히 가라앉았답니다.

en.title: One, Two, Three
en.body: Mom told him to count the numbers in his heart. As he counted one, two, three, the anger slowly settled down.
en.line: The more he counted, the smaller the balloon became.

ko.title: 마음을 말로
ko.body: 토토는 "탑이 무너져서 속상했어"라고 말했어요. 기분을 말로 꺼내자 답답함이 사르르 풀렸지요.

en.title: Saying How I Feel
en.body: Toto said, “I was sad because my tower fell.” When he put his feelings into words, the tightness melted away.
en.line: “I wasn't really angry. I was just sad.”

ko.title: 작아진 풍선
ko.body: 커다랗던 빨간 풍선이 손바닥만큼 작아졌어요. 토토의 얼굴빛도 다시 보송보송해졌답니다.

en.title: The Smaller Balloon
en.body: The big red balloon shrank until it was small as his palm. And Toto's face turned soft and calm again.
en.line: He didn't need to stomp his feet anymore.

ko.title: 다시 차곡차곡
ko.body: 토토는 무너진 도토리를 하나씩 다시 쌓기 시작했어요. 천천히 쌓으니 탑은 더 튼튼해졌지요.

en.title: Stacking Again, One by One
en.body: Toto began to stack the fallen acorns again, one by one. Going slowly, the tower grew even stronger.
en.line: Once his anger calmed, a good idea came to him.

ko.title: 함께 쌓는 탑
ko.body: 지나가던 친구가 함께 도토리를 올려 주었어요. 둘이 만든 탑은 가장 높고 멋졌답니다.

en.title: A Tower Built Together
en.body: A friend passing by helped him place the acorns on top. The tower they made together was the tallest and finest of all.
en.line: “It's more fun when we do it together!”

ko.title: 화가 날 때면
ko.body: 이제 토토는 화 풍선이 부풀면 후우 숨을 쉬어요. 그러면 풍선은 다시 작아진다는 걸 알았으니까요.

en.title: When I Feel Angry
en.body: Now when his anger balloon puffs up, Toto breathes out slow. Because he knows the balloon will shrink down again.
en.line: “Breathe out. One, two, three. I'm okay now.”
